description: Canonical Lemmings walk-cycle sprite, extracted 1:1 from the authoritative reference sheet (D:/Desarrollo/emote-display-firmware/.tools/lemmings-preview.png). The sheet is 576x576 with a uniform 12x integer magnification (verified: every 12x12 block is a single color), so the native sheet is 48x48 holding a 3x3 grid of 16x16 pose cells. Each frame below is trimmed to its bounding box and keeps its native offset (x, y) inside its 16x16 cell; every pose stands with feet on cell row 12. G = hair green, S = skin pink, B = tunic blue, '.' = transparent.
source: lemmings-preview.png (576x576, 12x magnified, native 48x48, palette: hair [0,179,0], skin [240,208,208], tunic [64,64,224], background black)
